domain_specific_rationale: From the Workflow Specialist perspective, deterministic idempotency key derivation SHA256(shot_version_id + prompt_version_id + provider_id + attempt_index + parameters_hash) is foundational for durable DAG execution, at-least-once task dispatch, and replay safety in Temporal/R06. When dispatching asynchronous generation tasks to external provider adapters (R07/R08/R09/R10), deterministic idempotency keys prevent duplicate generation jobs, accidental double-spend of credits, and conflicting duplicate take creation upon workflow activity retries or network partition recovery. Furthermore, explicitly binding attempt_index into the hash ensures that intentional re-renders or escalated retries generate fresh, non-colliding idempotency keys without corrupting previous attempt history.
capability_impact: Guarantees CAP-04 (Workflow Engine Orchestration) replay safety and task dispatch deduplication, and safeguards CAP-01 (Canonical Core State) and CAP-02 (Credit Settlement and Ledger Invariants).
residual_risk: Risk of divergent hash generation if parameters dictionary serialization is non-deterministic (e.g. varying key ordering across runtime environments). Mitigated by mandating RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) / sorted-key JSON serialization before computing parameters_hash.
